display_title: HORIZON-CL5-2026-11-D3-05 Demonstration of solid biofuel supply and conversion to high efficiency CHP from fully sustainable regional value chains – Horizon Europe
call_module_title: HORIZON-CL5-2026-11-D3-05 Demonstration of solid biofuel supply and conversion to high efficiency CHP from fully sustainable regional value chains
executive_summary: A Horizon Europe Innovation Action to demonstrate at least one regional value chain that turns locally sourced biogenic residues and wastes into upgraded solid biofuel and uses it in an operational high-efficiency combined heat and power plant of 10 to 30 MWe, reaching TRL 6-7. Standard Horizon Europe consortium rules apply (at least three independent legal entities from three Member States or Associated Countries); proposals should involve feedstock providers (e.g. farmers, foresters, municipalities) and must include social sciences and humanities expertise. The topic budget is EUR 13.50 million for around two projects of about EUR 6.75 million EU contribution each, funded at up to 70% (100% for non-profit entities). Single-stage; opened 4 August 2026, deadline 1 December 2026 at 17:00 Brussels time.
status_rationale: Climate, Energy and Mobility Work Programme 2026-2027 (Part 8), pp. 123–125, Specific conditions, Expected Outcome and Scope, funds the demonstration of regional solid-biofuel supply chains feeding a 10 to 30 MWe high-efficiency combined heat and power plant in a local industrial context. It does not touch TenneT's field: no project file is close to it, and although the expected outcomes mention flexible renewable power and bioenergy base load, the work concerns biomass logistics, fuel upgrading and plant operation at a scale typically connected below transmission level, with no task on grid integration, system operation or flexibility services.
